LanguageData.Duelo_Setting_LastLight_Desc: When a colonist dies, a small light flies from the body to the person who loved them most.
LanguageData.Duelo_Setting_Eulogy_Desc: At a funeral, or at a burial with mourners nearby, lines from the deceased's life rise from the grave with embers. The grave keeps the eulogy.
LanguageData.Duelo_Setting_EulogyLetter: Send the eulogy as a letter
LanguageData.Duelo_Setting_EulogyLetter_Desc: When the eulogy has been read, a letter with the full text arrives.
LanguageData.Duelo_Setting_EulogyAtBurial: Read the eulogy at burial even when a funeral is pending
LanguageData.Duelo_Setting_EulogyAtBurial_Desc: With Ideology, a burial normally stays silent when the colony owes the deceased a funeral: the funeral reads the eulogy instead.
LanguageData.Duelo_Setting_Moss_Desc: Graves of people the living still love slowly grow a soft moss that glows at night. It fades as those who loved them die or forget.
LanguageData.Duelo_ReadEulogyDesc: Read the words spoken for {0} at this grave.
LanguageData.Duelo_EulogyLetterFuneral: At {0}'s funeral, these words were spoken:
LanguageData.Duelo_EulogyLetterBurial: As {0} was laid to rest, those who loved them remembered:
